title: India's 'Savings Plan' for Delhi Residents Gets a Major Update
summary: The Indian government has announced an update to its 'Delhi Lakshmi Yojana', a program aimed at supporting low-income residents. The plan now promises ₹2500 per month, with recipients receiving ₹1000 in cash. The move is seen as part of the government's efforts to address poverty and inequality.
summary_points: The Indian government has updated its 'Delhi Lakshmi Yojana' program
The new plan promises ₹2500 per month for eligible residents
Recipients will receive ₹1000 in cash each month
title_hi: दिल्ली लक्ष्मी योजना को लेकर बड़ा अपडेट, हर महीने मिलेंगे ₹2500, पर हाथ में आएंगे हजार रुपए; जानिए सरकार का 'बचत प्लान'

framing.center: Centrist coverage focuses on the details of the updated plan, including the amount of money recipients will receive each month. They also mention that the government has promised to review the program's progress regularly.

framing_hi.center: केंद्रीय समाचार में योजना के विवरण पर ध्यान केंद्रित किया जाता है, जिसमें प्रति महीने ₹2500 रुपये प्राप्त करने वाले लोगों की संख्या शामिल है। सरकार ने योजना की समीक्षा के लिए नियमित रूप से समीक्षा की जाएगी।
